notes: Strip f: x 7860-10070 plus overlap to x 7560. Gilbert Avenue runs along the plate's east edge (printed AVENUE north, GILBERT south); its east side is cut by the plate edge, so its centreline is taken midway between the west block line and the plate edge (it matches the streetcar track). Stanton Avenue printed AVENUE north and STANTON south. Melrose Avenue printed MELROSE south of Locust and only AVENUE/AV north of Oak; assumed one street. Locust Street printed LOCUST west of Stanton and only ST. east. Oak Street jogs at Stanton (east section y~4780, west section y~5098). The bottom street is taken as McMillan Street: STREET is printed near x 7200 and McMILLAN at the plate's west end; its south side is the plate edge with stubs. Fredonia, Syracuse and Kerper are stubs north of Wehrman named from plate 69 (FREDONIA, SYRACUSE ... ST., KERPER ... AVE.). Stubs east of Gilbert printed CH..., FO..., YAL..., the unnamed stub at Lincoln, and the stubs south of McMillan printed ...CORD ST. and ...LEN... are cut by the plate edge; names unreadable (written ?). The stub south of McMillan at x~7483 (printed ...TON) lies just outside the overlap and is not picked. Omaha Street ends at the railroad at x~7700. Railroads (yard north of Beecher, the line along x 7700-7800) are not streets. Stanton Avenue drifts east going south (centre x ~8110 at Melish, ~8162 at McMillan).
